task: Estimate PM2.5 concentration at a Beijing monitoring station from same-hour meteorological and calendar information.
context: timestamp is local YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. station is the monitoring site. TEMP and DEWP: Celsius; PRES: hPa; RAIN: mm; wd: wind-direction category; WSPM: m/s. Other same-hour pollutant measurements are excluded. This is contemporaneous estimation, not forecasting from future observed weather.
